title: Pia Carrot e Youkoso!! We've Been Waiting for You (Demo)
native_title: Ｐｉａ・キャロットへようこそ！！
overview:
Yusuke has just finished high school, but after losing a bet with his father over his grades, his summer plans are gone. Instead of hanging out with friends, he has to spend the vacation working at Pia Carrot, a restaurant run by his family and staffed by a lively group of young women.

Pia Carrot e Youkoso!! is a dating simulation. Each day is split into morning, afternoon and after work. Study or make phone calls in your free time, take shifts as cashier, waiter or cook to raise stats such as Style, Kindness and Guts, keep an eye on your money, and get to know your co-workers - call them up and ask them out on dates.

This disc is a demo version of the game.

- 1 player
- Shuttle Mouse support
- Rated for ages 18 and over
